build_deforamble_transformer: build a DeformableTransformer model from argparse args with configurable encoder decoder layers and feature levels
DeformableTransformer_forward: run the DeformableTransformer forward pass with multi-scale source features masks and positional embeddings
DeformableTransformerEncoderLayer_forwar: run a single encoder layer with multi-scale deformable attention and feed-forward network on source features
DeformableTransformerDecoderLayer_forwar: run a single decoder layer with self-attention cross-attention and feed-forward network on target queries
DeformableTransformer_gen_encoder_output: generate encoder output proposals and normalized memory from encoder memory padding masks and spatial shapes
